## CommonFormatter.min() method

Sets the minimum value for the formatter.

This method configures the formatter to apply a lower bound to the values being formatted. If the value being formatted is below the specified minimum, it will be replaced with a representation like `< minValue`<!-- -->.

If `_m` is `null` or `undefined`<!-- -->, the current instance is returned without modification.

**Signature:**

```typescript
min(_m: number | undefined | null): this;
```

A new formatter instance with the `min` option set to the specified value, or the current instance if `_m` is `null` or `undefined`<!-- -->.

## Example

const updatedFormatter = formatter.min(10); console.log(updatedFormatter.of(5)); // Output: "<!-- -->&lt; 10"
